contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: [text: optional eyebrow paragraph, H2, paragraph, CTA link] | [picture] (either order)
contentPattern.summary: One media column (single image) paired with one text column (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, CTA). Supports image on either side.

usage.reuseGuidance: Use for image + text feature bands on a colored/grey section background. Add the 'reverse' option to place the image on the right and text on the left.

options.label: Reverse
options.description: Places the media column on the right and the text column on the left (desktop).

options.label: Full-bleed image
options.description: 50/50 split: the image fills its half edge to edge (object-fit: cover, no padding) and the text half is padded with the gutter. Works on sky-blue, grey, charcoal and white bands and overrides the sky-blue inset-image look. Cell order decides which side the image is on.
